title: Rethinking infidelity ... a talk for anyone who has ever loved
speaker: Esther Perel

sentences.en: Why do we cheat? And why do happy people cheat?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们作弊 为什么快乐的人作弊

sentences.en: And when we say "infidelity," what exactly do we mean?
sentences.zh: 当我们说"不忠"时 我们到底是什么意思?

sentences.en: Is it a hookup, a love story, paid sex, a chat room, a massage with a happy ending?
sentences.zh: 是勾结,爱情故事,有偿性爱,聊天室, 按摩和快乐结局?

sentences.en: Why do we think that men cheat out of boredom and fear of intimacy, but women cheat out of loneliness and hunger for intimacy?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么认为男人会因为无聊和害怕亲密而作弊,而女人却会因为孤独和渴望亲密而作弊?

sentences.en: And is an affair always the end of a relationship?
sentences.zh: 婚外情总是感情的终结吗?

sentences.en: For the past 10 years, I have traveled the globe and worked extensively with hundreds of couples who have been shattered by infidelity.
sentences.zh: 过去10年来,我环游全球,与几百对因不忠而粉碎的夫妇广泛合作。

sentences.en: There is one simple act of transgression that can rob a couple of their relationship, their happiness and their very identity: an affair.
sentences.zh: 一种简单的违法行径 能够剥夺一对夫妇的关系, 他们的幸福和他们的身份 一种外遇。

sentences.en: And yet, this extremely common act is so poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 然而,这一极为常见的行为却鲜为人知。

sentences.en: So this talk is for anyone who has ever loved.
sentences.zh: 所以这次谈话是为爱过的人准备的

sentences.en: Adultery has existed since marriage was invented, and so, too, the taboo against it.
sentences.zh: 通奸自婚以来就存在了, 也存在禁忌。

sentences.en: In fact, infidelity has a tenacity that marriage can only envy, so much so, that this is the only commandment that is repeated twice in the Bible:
sentences.zh: 事实上,不忠有坚韧不拔的毅力 婚姻只能羡慕 如此之多 这是圣经中重复过两次的唯一戒律

sentences.en: once for doing it, and once just for thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 一次是为了做它, 一次只是为了思考它。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So how do we reconcile what is universally forbidden, yet universally practiced?
sentences.zh: 那么,我们如何调和什么是普遍禁止的,但普遍实行?

sentences.en: Now, throughout history, men practically had a license to cheat with little consequence, and supported by a host of biological and evolutionary theories that justified their need to roam,
sentences.zh: 现在,纵观历史, 男人实际上有 许可证作弊 没有什么后果, 并得到支持 大量的生物学和进化理论 证明他们需要漫游,

sentences.en: so the double standard is as old as adultery itself.
sentences.zh: 所以双重标准和通奸一样古老

sentences.en: But who knows what's really going on under the sheets there, right?
sentences.zh: 但谁知道床单底下到底发生了什么,对吧?

sentences.en: Because when it comes to sex, the pressure for men is to boast and to exaggerate, but the pressure for women is to hide, minimize and deny, which isn't surprising when you consider that there are still nine countries
sentences.zh: 因为,在性方面,男人的压力是吹嘘和夸大, 但女人的压力是隐藏, 最小化和否认,

sentences.en: where women can be killed for straying. Now, monogamy used to be one person for life.
sentences.zh: 现在,一夫一妻制曾经是终身一体。

sentences.en: Today, monogamy is one person at a time.
sentences.zh: 今天,一夫一妻制是一个人。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) I mean, many of you probably have said, "I am monogamous in all my relationships."
sentences.zh: (掌声) (掌声) 我的意思是,你们中许多人可能已经说, "我是一夫一妻制的,我的所有关系。"

sentences.en: (Laughter) We used to marry, and had sex for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我们以前结婚 第一次做爱

sentences.en: But now we marry, and we stop having sex with others.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们结婚 不再和别人做爱了

sentences.en: The fact is that monogamy had nothing to do with love.
sentences.zh: 事实上一夫一妻制与爱情无关

sentences.en: Men relied on women's fidelity in order to know whose children these are, and who gets the cows when I die.
sentences.zh: 男人靠女人的忠贞 才能知道这些孩子是谁 我死后谁得到奶牛

sentences.en: Now, everyone wants to know what percentage of people cheat.
sentences.zh: 现在,每个人都想知道 多少人作弊。

sentences.en: I've been asked that question since I arrived at this conference.
sentences.zh: 自从我到会后,我一直问这个问题

sentences.en: (Laughter) It applies to you. But the definition of infidelity keeps on expanding: sexting, watching porn, staying secretly active on dating apps.
sentences.zh: 它适用于你。但是不忠的定义在不断扩大:性爱、看色情片、在约会应用程序上保持秘密活跃。

sentences.en: So because there is no universally agreed-upon definition of what even constitutes an infidelity, estimates vary widely, from 26 percent to 75 percent.
sentences.zh: 因此,由于对什么甚至构成不忠没有普遍同意的定义,估计值差别很大,从26%到75%不等。

sentences.en: But on top of it, we are walking contradictions.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是,我们是在走矛盾。

sentences.en: So 95 percent of us will say that it is terribly wrong for our partner to lie about having an affair, but just about the same amount of us will say that that's exactly what we would do if we were having one.
sentences.zh: 我们95%的人会说 我们的搭档撒谎 有关有外遇是大错特错, 但是大约同样多的人会说, 如果我们有外遇,我们就会这样做。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Now, I like this definition of an affair -- it brings together the three key elements: a secretive relationship, which is the core structure of an affair;
sentences.zh: (笑声) 现在,我喜欢这个关于外遇的定义—— 它把三个关键要素结合在一起: 一种秘密的关系,这是外遇的核心结构;

sentences.en: an emotional connection to one degree or another; and a sexual alchemy.
sentences.zh: 某种程度的情感联系 和一种性炼金术

sentences.en: And alchemy is the key word here, because the erotic frisson is such that the kiss that you only imagine giving, can be as powerful and as enchanting
sentences.zh: 炼金术是这里的关键词, 因为色情的皮条客是这样的吻 你只能想象 给予,可以那么强大 和迷人

sentences.en: as hours of actual lovemaking. As Marcel Proust said, it's our imagination that is responsible for love, not the other person.
sentences.zh: 正如马赛尔·普鲁斯特所说,我们的想象力是爱情的责任,而不是另一个人。

sentences.en: So it's never been easier to cheat, and it's never been more difficult to keep a secret.
sentences.zh: 所以作弊从来就不那么容易 也从未这么难保守秘密

sentences.en: And never has infidelity exacted such a psychological toll.
sentences.zh: 从来没有不忠 造成这样的心理伤害。

sentences.en: When marriage was an economic enterprise, infidelity threatened our economic security.
sentences.zh: 当婚姻是一个经济企业时,不忠威胁到我们的经济安全。

sentences.en: But now that marriage is a romantic arrangement, infidelity threatens our emotional security.
sentences.zh: 但是现在婚姻是个浪漫的安排 不忠会威胁我们的感情安全

sentences.en: Ironically, we used to turn to adultery -- that was the space where we sought pure love.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是,我们过去常常转向通奸 -- -- 这就是我们寻求纯爱的地方。

sentences.en: But now that we seek love in marriage, adultery destroys it.
sentences.zh: 但既然我们在婚姻中寻求爱 通奸就毁了它

sentences.en: Now, there are three ways that I think infidelity hurts differently today.
sentences.zh: 现在,有三种方式 我认为不忠 伤害今天不同。

sentences.en: We have a romantic ideal in which we turn to one person to fulfill an endless list of needs: to be my greatest lover, my best friend,
sentences.zh: 我们有一个浪漫的理想 我们向一个人求助 满足无穷无尽的需求: 做我最伟大的情人, 我最好的朋友,

sentences.en: the best parent, my trusted confidant, my emotional companion, my intellectual equal.
sentences.zh: 最好的父母 我信任的知己 我的情感伴侣 我的智力平等

sentences.en: And I am it: I'm chosen, I'm unique, I'm indispensable, I'm irreplaceable, I'm the one.
sentences.zh: 我被选中了,我独一无二,我不可或缺,我不可替代,我是唯一的人。

sentences.en: And infidelity tells me I'm not. It is the ultimate betrayal.
sentences.zh: 不忠告诉我我不是,这是终极背叛

sentences.en: Infidelity shatters the grand ambition of love.
sentences.zh: 不忠粉碎了爱的大野心

sentences.en: But if throughout history, infidelity has always been painful, today it is often traumatic, because it threatens our sense of self.
sentences.zh: 但是,如果在整个历史中,不忠始终是痛苦的,那么今天,它往往是创伤性的,因为它威胁到我们的自我意识。

sentences.en: So my patient Fernando, he's plagued. He goes on: "I thought I knew my life.
sentences.zh: 我的病人Fernando,他受苦了,他接着说: “我以为我知道我的生活。

sentences.en: I thought I knew who you were, who we were as a couple, who I was.
sentences.zh: 我想我知道你是谁,我们是一对夫妇,我是谁。

sentences.en: Now, I question everything." Infidelity -- a violation of trust, a crisis of identity.
sentences.zh: 现在,我质疑一切。"不忠, 违反信任, 身份危机。

sentences.en: "Can I ever trust you again?" he asks. "Can I ever trust anyone again?"
sentences.zh: "我能再信任你吗?"他问 "我能再信任任何人吗?"

sentences.en: And this is also what my patient Heather is telling me, when she's talking to me about her story with Nick.
sentences.zh: 这也是我病人Heather告诉我的 当她跟我谈她和Nick的故事时

sentences.en: Married, two kids. Nick just left on a business trip, and Heather is playing on his iPad with the boys, when she sees a message appear on the screen: "Can't wait to see you."
sentences.zh: 尼克刚去出差 Heather正在和孩子们玩iPad

sentences.en: Strange, she thinks, we just saw each other.
sentences.zh: 奇怪,她认为,我们刚刚见面。

sentences.en: And then another message: "Can't wait to hold you in my arms."
sentences.zh: 然后另一个信息: "等不及要抱住你在我的怀里。"

sentences.en: And Heather realizes these are not for her.
sentences.zh: Heather意识到这些不是给她的

sentences.en: She also tells me that her father had affairs, but her mother, she found one little receipt in the pocket, and a little bit of lipstick on the collar.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉我她父亲有外遇 但她妈妈在口袋里 发现了一张小收据 领子上还有一点口红

sentences.en: Heather, she goes digging, and she finds hundreds of messages, and photos exchanged and desires expressed.
sentences.zh: 希瑟,她去挖掘, 她发现数百条信息, 和照片交换 和表达的愿望。

sentences.en: The vivid details of Nick's two-year affair unfold in front of her in real time, And it made me think: Affairs in the digital age are death by a thousand cuts.
sentences.zh: 尼克的两年婚外情的生动细节 在她面前展现在实时, 它让我想到: 数字时代的事务是千分之一的死亡。

sentences.en: But then we have another paradox that we're dealing with these days.
sentences.zh: 但是,我们又有另一个悖论, 这些天我们处理。

sentences.en: Because of this romantic ideal, we are relying on our partner's fidelity with a unique fervor.
sentences.zh: 因为这个浪漫的理想, 我们依靠我们的伙伴的忠诚 与独特的欢乐。

sentences.en: But we also have never been more inclined to stray, and not because we have new desires today, but because we live in an era where we feel that we are entitled to pursue our desires, because this is the culture where I deserve to be happy.
sentences.zh: 但是,我们也从未像现在这样倾向于偏离方向,不是因为我们今天有新的愿望,而是因为我们生活在一个我们感到有权追求自己愿望的时代,因为这正是我应该得到幸福的文化。

sentences.en: And if we used to divorce because we were unhappy, today we divorce because we could be happier.
sentences.zh: 如果我们以前因为不快乐而离婚 今天我们离婚 因为我们会更快乐

sentences.en: And if divorce carried all the shame, today, choosing to stay when you can leave is the new shame.
sentences.zh: 如果离婚带来所有的耻辱, 今天,选择留下 当你可以离开是新的耻辱。

sentences.en: So Heather, she can't talk to her friends because she's afraid that they will judge her for still loving Nick, and everywhere she turns, she gets the same advice: Leave him. Throw the dog on the curb.
sentences.zh: 所以Heather,她不能和她的朋友说话 因为她害怕他们会评判她是否仍然爱Nick, 每当她转身,她都会得到同样的忠告:离开他。把狗扔到路边去。

sentences.en: And if the situation were reversed, Nick would be in the same situation.
sentences.zh: 如果情况发生逆转 尼克也会处于同样的情况

sentences.en: Staying is the new shame. So if we can divorce, why do we still have affairs?
sentences.zh: 留下来是新的耻辱 如果我们能离婚 为什么我们还有事?

sentences.en: Now, the typical assumption is that if someone cheats, either there's something wrong in your relationship or wrong with you.
sentences.zh: 现在,典型的假设是,如果有人作弊, 要么是你的关系有问题 要么是你与你的关系有问题。

sentences.en: But millions of people can't all be pathological.
sentences.zh: 但数以百万计的人不可能都是病态的

sentences.en: The logic goes like this: If you have everything you need at home, then there is no need to go looking elsewhere, assuming that there is such a thing as a perfect marriage that will inoculate us against wanderlust.
sentences.zh: 逻辑是这样的:如果你家里有你需要的一切, 那么就没有必要去别的地方找了, 假设有一个完美的婚姻 来保护我们不受游荡的影响。

sentences.en: But what if passion has a finite shelf life?
sentences.zh: 但如果激情有一定的保存寿命呢?

sentences.en: What if there are things that even a good relationship can never provide?
sentences.zh: 如果有些事情 即使是良好的关系 也永远无法提供呢?

sentences.en: If even happy people cheat, what is it about?
sentences.zh: 即使快乐的人作弊,它是什么?

sentences.en: The vast majority of people that I actually work with are not at all chronic philanderers.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数我实际工作的人 根本不是长期的花花公子

sentences.en: They are often people who are deeply monogamous in their beliefs, and at least for their partner.
sentences.zh: 他们往往是在自己的信仰上,至少对其伴侣来说是一夫一妻制根深蒂固的人。

sentences.en: But they find themselves in a conflict between their values and their behavior.
sentences.zh: 但他们发现自己在他们的价值观和行为之间有冲突。

sentences.en: They often are people who have actually been faithful for decades, but one day they cross a line that they never thought they would cross, and at the risk of losing everything.
sentences.zh: 他们往往是真正忠诚的人 数十年来, 但有一天,他们越过了一条 他们从未想过会跨越的界线, 并冒着失去一切的风险。

sentences.en: But for a glimmer of what? Affairs are an act of betrayal, and they are also an expression of longing and loss.
sentences.zh: 但对于一线什么? 事务是一种背叛行为,它们也是渴望和失去的表现。

sentences.en: At the heart of an affair, you will often find a longing and a yearning for an emotional connection, for novelty, for freedom, for autonomy, for sexual intensity,
sentences.zh: 在外遇的核心,你会发现 渴望和渴望 情感联系, 新颖, 自由, 自主, 性密集,

sentences.en: a wish to recapture lost parts of ourselves or an attempt to bring back vitality in the face of loss and tragedy.
sentences.zh: 想要夺回自己的一部分 或试图恢复活力 面对损失和悲剧。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about another patient of mine, Priya, who is blissfully married, loves her husband, and would never want to hurt the man.
sentences.zh: 我在想我的另一个病人 Priya 她幸福地结婚了 爱着她的丈夫 绝不会伤害他

sentences.en: But she also tells me that she's always done what was expected of her: good girl, good wife, good mother, taking care of her immigrant parents.
sentences.zh: 但她也告诉我,她总是做 期待她做的事: 好女孩,好妻子,好母亲, 照顾她的移民父母。

sentences.en: Priya, she fell for the arborist who removed the tree from her yard after Hurricane Sandy.
sentences.zh: Priya,她爱上了飓风桑迪后 将树从院子里移走的Arborist。

sentences.en: And with his truck and his tattoos, he's quite the opposite of her.
sentences.zh: 他的卡车和纹身 和她完全相反

sentences.en: But at 47, Priya's affair is about the adolescence that she never had.
sentences.zh: 但到了47岁 Priya的婚外情 是关于她从未有过的青春期

sentences.en: And her story highlights for me that when we seek the gaze of another, it isn't always our partner that we are turning away from, but the person that we have ourselves become.
sentences.zh: 她的故事向我强调 当我们寻找别人的视线时 我们并非总是抛弃我们的伴侣 而是我们自己所变成的人

sentences.en: And it isn't so much that we're looking for another person, as much as we are looking for another self.
sentences.zh: 我们要找的不是另一个人 而是另一个自我

sentences.en: Now, all over the world, there is one word that people who have affairs always tell me.
sentences.zh: 现在,在世界各地,有一个词, 有事情的人总是告诉我。

sentences.en: They feel alive. And they often will tell me stories of recent losses -- of a parent who died, and a friend that went too soon, and bad news at the doctor.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己还活着。他们常常会告诉我最近失去亲人的故事-- 一个父母去世了,一个朋友过早去世了,还有医生的坏消息。

sentences.en: Death and mortality often live in the shadow of an affair, because they raise these questions.
sentences.zh: 死亡和死亡往往生活在外遇的阴影下,因为它们提出了这些问题。

sentences.en: Is this it? Is there more? Am I going on for another 25 years like this?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗 还有更多吗 我还能这样过25年吗

sentences.en: Will I ever feel that thing again? And it has led me to think that perhaps these questions are the ones that propel people to cross the line,
sentences.zh: 我还能感觉到吗?这让我觉得 这些问题或许是 驱使人们跨越界限的问题。

sentences.en: and that some affairs are an attempt to beat back deadness, in an antidote to death.
sentences.zh: 有些事是想用解毒剂击退死亡

sentences.en: And contrary to what you may think, affairs are way less about sex, and a lot more about desire: desire for attention, desire to feel special, desire to feel important.
sentences.zh: 与你所想的相反,事情不是关于性, 而是更多的关于欲望: 渴望关注,渴望感到特殊,渴望感觉重要。

sentences.en: And the very structure of an affair, the fact that you can never have your lover, keeps you wanting.
sentences.zh: 外遇的结构, 你永远不能拥有你的爱人, 使你一直渴望。

sentences.en: That in itself is a desire machine, because the incompleteness, the ambiguity, keeps you wanting that which you can't have.
sentences.zh: 这本身就是一个欲望机器, 因为不完整,模糊, 让你一直想要你无法拥有的东西。

sentences.en: Now some of you probably think that affairs don't happen in open relationships, but they do.
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人可能认为 事务不会发生在公开的关系中, 但是他们这样做了。

sentences.en: First of all, the conversation about monogamy is not the same as the conversation about infidelity.
sentences.zh: 首先,关于一夫一妻制的谈话与关于不忠的谈话不同。

sentences.en: But the fact is that it seems that even when we have the freedom to have other sexual partners, we still seem to be lured by the power of the forbidden, that if we do that which we are not supposed to do,
sentences.zh: 但事实是,似乎即使我们有 拥有其他性伴侣的自由, 我们似乎仍然被引诱 受禁止的力量, 如果我们做 我们不应该做的,

sentences.en: then we feel like we are really doing what we want to.
sentences.zh: 然后,我们觉得我们真的在做我们想要做的事。

sentences.en: And I've also told quite a few of my patients that if they could bring into their relationships one tenth of the boldness, the imagination and the verve that they put into their affairs,
sentences.zh: 我还告诉我的很多病人，如果他们能把他们在事务中投入的十分之一的勇气、想象力和热情带入他们的关系中，

sentences.en: they probably would never need to see me.
sentences.zh: 他们可能永远不需要见我。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So how do we heal from an affair?
sentences.zh: （笑声） 那么我们如何从婚外情中恢复过来呢？

sentences.en: Desire runs deep. Betrayal runs deep. But it can be healed.
sentences.zh: 欲望根深蒂固。背叛根深蒂固。但它是可以治愈的。

sentences.en: And some affairs are death knells for relationships that were already dying on the vine.
sentences.zh: 有些事情对已经濒临死亡的关系来说是丧钟。

sentences.en: But others will jolt us into new possibilities.
sentences.zh: 但其他人将会给我们带来新的可能性。

sentences.en: The fact is, the majority of couples who have experienced affairs stay together.
sentences.zh: 事实是，大多数经历过外遇的夫妻都会在一起。

sentences.en: But some of them will merely survive, and others will actually be able to turn a crisis into an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 但其中一些只会生存下来，而另一些则实际上能够将危机转化为机遇。

sentences.en: They'll be able to turn this into a generative experience.
sentences.zh: 他们将能够将其转化为一种创造性的体验。

sentences.en: And I'm actually thinking even more so for the deceived partner, who will often say, "You think I didn't want more?
sentences.zh: 事实上，我对被欺骗的伴侣的想法更是如此，他们经常会说：“你认为我不想要更多吗？

sentences.en: But I'm not the one who did it." But now that the affair is exposed, they, too, get to claim more, and they no longer have to uphold the status quo that may not have been working for them that well, either.
sentences.zh: 但我不是做这件事的人。”但现在事情被曝光了，他们也可以要求更多，而且他们也不再需要维持可能对他们不太有利的现状。

sentences.en: I've noticed that a lot of couples, in the immediate aftermath of an affair, because of this new disorder that may actually lead to a new order, will have depths of conversations with honesty and openness
sentences.zh: 我注意到，很多夫妻在婚外情发生后，由于这种新的混乱实际上可能会导致新的秩序，他们会进行诚实和开放的深入对话

sentences.en: that they haven't had in decades. And, partners who were sexually indifferent find themselves suddenly so lustfully voracious, they don't know where it's coming from.
sentences.zh: 这是他们几十年来从未有过的。而且，性冷淡的伴侣发现自己突然变得如此贪婪，他们不知道它从何而来。

sentences.en: Something about the fear of loss will rekindle desire, and make way for an entirely new kind of truth.
sentences.zh: 对失去的恐惧会重新点燃欲望，并为一种全新的真理让路。

sentences.en: So when an affair is exposed, what are some of the specific things that couples can do?
sentences.zh: 那么，当婚外情被曝光后，夫妻双方可以做哪些具体的事情呢？

sentences.en: We know from trauma that healing begins when the perpetrator acknowledges their wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 我们从创伤中知道，当肇事者承认自己的错误行为时，治愈就开始了。

sentences.en: So for the partner who had the affair, for Nick, one thing is to end the affair, but the other is the essential, important act of expressing guilt and remorse for hurting his wife.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于有外遇的伴侣，对于尼克来说，一件事是结束外遇，但另一件事是表达对伤害妻子的内疚和悔恨的基本、重要的行为。

sentences.en: But the truth is that I have noticed that quite a lot of people who have affairs may feel terribly guilty for hurting their partner, but they don't feel guilty for the experience of the affair itself.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，我注意到很多有外遇的人可能会因为伤害了自己的伴侣而感到非常内疚，但他们并不会对外遇本身的经历感到内疚。

sentences.en: And that distinction is important. And Nick, he needs to hold vigil for the relationship.
sentences.zh: 这种区别很重要。而尼克，他需要为这段关系保持警惕。

sentences.en: He needs to become, for a while, the protector of the boundaries.
sentences.zh: 他需要暂时成为边界的保护者。

sentences.en: It's his responsibility to bring it up, because if he thinks about it, he can relieve Heather from the obsession, and from having to make sure that the affair isn't forgotten, and that in itself begins to restore trust.
sentences.zh: 他有责任提出这件事，因为如果他想到这一点，他就可以把希瑟从痴迷中解脱出来，也不必确保这件事不被遗忘，而这本身就开始恢复信任。

sentences.en: But for Heather, or deceived partners, it is essential to do things that bring back a sense of self-worth, to surround oneself with love and with friends and activities
sentences.zh: 但对于希瑟或被欺骗的伴侣来说，做一些能让自己找回自我价值感的事情、让自己充满爱、朋友和活动是至关重要的

sentences.en: that give back joy and meaning and identity.
sentences.zh: 回归欢乐、意义和身份。

sentences.en: But even more important, is to curb the curiosity to mine for the sordid details -- Where were you? Where did you do it?
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，抑制住对肮脏细节的好奇心——你在哪里？你在哪里做的？

sentences.en: How often? Is she better than me in bed? -- questions that only inflict more pain, and keep you awake at night.
sentences.zh: 多常？她床上功夫比我好吗？ ——这些问题只会带来更多痛苦，让你彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: And instead, switch to what I call the investigative questions, the ones that mine the meaning and the motives -- What did this affair mean for you?
sentences.zh: 相反，转向我所说的调查问题，即挖掘意义和动机的问题——这件事对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: What were you able to express or experience there that you could no longer do with me?
sentences.zh: 你在那里能够表达或体验到哪些事情是你无法再对我做的？

sentences.en: What was it like for you when you came home?
sentences.zh: 你回家后感觉如何？

sentences.en: What is it about us that you value? Are you pleased this is over?
sentences.zh: 您看重我们的哪些方面？这件事结束了你高兴吗？

sentences.en: Every affair will redefine a relationship, and every couple will determine what the legacy of the affair will be.
sentences.zh: 每一次外遇都会重新定义一段关系，每对夫妇都会决定外遇的遗产是什么。

sentences.en: But affairs are here to stay, and they're not going away.
sentences.zh: 但事情会一直存在，不会消失。

sentences.en: And the dilemmas of love and desire, they don't yield just simple answers of black and white and good and bad, and victim and perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 而爱与欲望的困境，并不仅仅产生非黑即白、好与坏、受害者与加害者的简单答案。

sentences.en: Betrayal in a relationship comes in many forms.
sentences.zh: 关系中的背叛有多种形式。

sentences.en: There are many ways that we betray our partner: with contempt, with neglect, with indifference, with violence.
sentences.zh: 我们背叛伴侣的方式有很多种：蔑视、忽视、冷漠、暴力。

sentences.en: Sexual betrayal is only one way to hurt a partner.
sentences.zh: 性背叛只是伤害伴侣的一种方式。

sentences.en: In other words, the victim of an affair is not always the victim of the marriage.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，婚外情的受害者并不总是婚姻的受害者。

sentences.en: Now, you've listened to me, and I know what you're thinking: She has a French accent, she must be pro-affair.
sentences.zh: 现在，你听了我的话，我知道你在想什么：她有法国口音，她一定是支持外遇的。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So, you're wrong. I am not French.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 所以，你错了。我不是法国人。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) And I'm not pro-affair.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）我并不赞成外遇。

sentences.en: But because I think that good can come out of an affair, I have often been asked this very strange question: Would I ever recommend it?
sentences.zh: 但因为我认为外遇可以带来好处，所以经常有人问我这个非常奇怪的问题：我会推荐它吗？

sentences.en: Now, I would no more recommend you have an affair than I would recommend you have cancer, and yet we know that people who have been ill often talk about how their illness has yielded them a new perspective.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不会建议你有外遇，就像我不会建议你患癌症一样，但我们知道，生病的人经常谈论他们的疾病如何给他们带来了新的视角。

sentences.en: The main question that I've been asked since I arrived at this conference when I said I would talk about infidelity is, for or against?
sentences.zh: 自从我参加这次会议以来，当我说我要谈论不忠问题时，我被问到的主要问题是，支持还是反对？

sentences.en: I said, "Yes." (Laughter) I look at affairs from a dual perspective: hurt and betrayal on one side,
sentences.zh: 我说：“是的。” （笑声）我从双重角度看待事情：一方面是伤害，一方面是背叛，

sentences.en: growth and self-discovery on the other -- what it did to you, and what it meant for me.
sentences.zh: 另一方面是成长和自我发现——它对你做了什么，对我意味着什么。

sentences.en: And so when a couple comes to me in the aftermath of an affair that has been revealed, I will often tell them this: Today in the West, most of us are going to have two or three relationships
sentences.zh: 因此，当一对夫妇在外遇被揭露后来找我时，我经常会告诉他们：今天在西方，我们大多数人都会有两到三段关系。

sentences.en: or marriages, and some of us are going to do it with the same person.
sentences.zh: 或者婚姻，我们中的一些人会和同一个人结婚。

sentences.en: Your first marriage is over. Would you like to create a second one together?
sentences.zh: 你的第一次婚姻结束了。您想一起创建第二个吗？

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢。 （掌声）
